name: @stewardmd/capacitor-needle
description: On-device Needle 3 (Cactus) router engine for StewardMD Edge. Text in, one JSON tool call out; nothing leaves the device. Android runs the engine in its own process (:edge) so a stuck call can be killed.
author: StewardMD
_vendored: StewardMD-authored local plugin wrapping the prebuilt Needle 3 engine (libneedle.a) from huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/needle3. The engine binaries and weights are NOT in git: run scripts/fetch-needle.sh (pinned sha256). NOT YET BUILT OR RUN ON A DEVICE: see README, gates A0.1 and A0.2.
